events.title: Third Moment reports running 10,000 agents for multi-day research
events.title_zh: Third Moment 披露万级 agent 连续运行多日
events.summary: An OpenAI customer story says Third Moment Research runs up to 10,000 concurrent agents for 36 to 48 hours, consuming roughly one trillion OpenAI tokens per day. Its default worker is Codex inside Docker, while outer GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol agents retry, terminate or escalate stalled work. The article is a vendor-hosted customer account and provides no raw telemetry or independent validation.

Its default worker is Codex inside Docker, while outer GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol agents retry, terminate or escalate stalled work. The article is a vendor-hosted customer account and provides no raw telemetry or independent validation.

events.why_it_matters: This is a concrete account of long-running agent operations at unusually high scale, including supervision rather than only model quality. It is useful as an architecture signal, but teams should not generalize the reported throughput or optimization gains without workload-level evidence.

It is useful as an architecture signal, but teams should not generalize the reported throughput or optimization gains without workload-level evidence.

events.title: OpenAI schedules retirement for GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 API snapshots
events.title_zh: OpenAI 将停用一批 GPT-4o 与 GPT-4.1 API snapshot
events.summary: OpenAI says customers were notified on October 14 that named GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini and GPT-4.1 API snapshots, including fine-tuned variants, will be removed on January 14, 2027. The affected snapshots remain callable now; this is a scheduled shutdown, not an immediate removal. OpenAI recommends gpt-6-luna as the replacement.
events.summary_en: OpenAI says customers were notified on October 14 that named GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini and GPT-4.1 API snapshots, including fine-tuned variants, will be removed on January 14, 2027. The affected snapshots remain callable now; this is a scheduled shutdown, not an immediate removal. OpenAI recommends gpt-6-luna as the replacement.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，客户在 10 月 14 日收到通知：一批指定的 GPT-4o、GPT-4o mini 与 GPT-4.1 API snapshot 及其微调版本，将于 2027 年 1 月 14 日停用。相关 snapshot 现在仍可调用；这是计划下线，不是已经移除。OpenAI 建议迁移到 gpt-6-luna。
events.why_it_matters: Production users have a fixed migration deadline that can affect behavior, latency, price and fine-tuned assets. Inventory exact model IDs now and validate the replacement on representative evaluations rather than relying on alias-level assumptions.
events.why_it_matters_en: Production users have a fixed migration deadline that can affect behavior, latency, price and fine-tuned assets. Inventory exact model IDs now and validate the replacement on representative evaluations rather than relying on alias-level assumptions.

events.title: Ai2 releases HiRO-ACEv2 for kilometer-scale climate emulation
events.title_zh: Ai2 发布公里级气候模拟模型 HiRO-ACEv2
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 HiRO-ACEv2 模型、教程和示例，用 100 公里分辨率的 ACE 全球模拟生成 3 公里天气场。作者称它能处理降水、风和气压，包括极端事件，并把一年全球模拟的成本降到高分辨率物理模型的大约三百分之一。模型只适用于按 X-SHiELD 调过的 ACE 输入，不能直接模拟更暖未来或 ERA5 历史气候。
events.summary_en: Ai2 released the HiRO-ACEv2 model, tutorials and examples for turning 100-kilometer ACE global simulations into 3-kilometer weather fields. The authors say it handles precipitation, wind and pressure, including extremes, at roughly one-three-hundredth the cost of the high-resolution physical model. It only works with ACE tuned to X-SHiELD and cannot directly simulate warmer futures or ERA5 historical climate.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对气候基础设施团队来说，这说明生成式降尺度开始覆盖多变量和极端事件，而不只是做一张更清晰的图。适用域很窄，作者结果也未独立复现，因此只能在相同 X-SHiELD 条件下试验。
events.why_it_matters_en: For climate-infrastructure teams, generative downscaling is moving beyond sharper images toward multivariable and extreme-event behavior. The domain is narrow and results are not independently reproduced, so trials should stay within the same X-SHiELD conditions.

technical_details.pipeline: ACE at roughly 100 km to HiROv2 at 3 km
technical_details.author_results: statistics within 3% of X-SHiELD even near one-in-a-million points; roughly 1/300th cost
technical_details.limits: requires ACE tuned to X-SHiELD; not suitable for warmer-future or ERA5 historical climate; hurricane-eye winds and pressure remain asymmetric

technical_details_zh.流水线: 约 100 公里的 ACE 输入，生成 3 公里 HiROv2 输出
technical_details_zh.作者结果: 即使接近百万分之一极端点，统计量也在 X-SHiELD 的 3% 内；成本约为三百分之一
technical_details_zh.限制: 要求针对 X-SHiELD 调整的 ACE；不能用于更暖未来或 ERA5 历史气候；飓风眼附近风和气压仍偏斜

events.next_action_en: Within one day, run one public X-SHiELD example and compare extreme quantiles, spatial structure, runtime and memory.

events.title: xAI makes Grok Voice 3.0 generally available at the existing price
events.title_zh: xAI 以原价正式开放 Grok Voice 3.0
events.summary_zh: xAI 将 Grok Voice 3.0 作为 Voice Agent API 的 GA 模型开放，价格维持每分钟 0.08 美元，endpoint 与 session 参数不变。`grok-voice-latest` 已自动指向 3.0，未锁定版本的会话会随别名切换。
events.summary_en: xAI made Grok Voice 3.0 generally available through the Voice Agent API at the existing $0.08 per minute. Endpoints and session parameters are unchanged. The `grok-voice-latest` alias now points to 3.0, so unpinned sessions move automatically.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对生产语音 agent 团队来说，可用阶段与价格已经明确，但自动别名迁移会把模型行为变化带进现有会话。厂商引用的企业准确率和延迟数据没有在本轮独立复测，升级前仍需按自己的口音、中断、工具调用与升级路径回归。
events.why_it_matters_en: For production voice-agent teams, availability and price are clear, but automatic alias migration can change behavior in existing sessions. Vendor-cited enterprise accuracy and latency were not reproduced, so accents, interruption, tool use and escalation still need local regression.

technical_details.limits: xAI-cited external benchmark and deployment claims were not independently reproduced
